value.rationale: An exact complete Euclidean four-vertex simplex-volume invariant of the regular truncated octahedron, simultaneously the 3D four-letter permutohedron and body-centered-cubic Voronoi cell, is a natural geometric classification. The spectrum has no missing 1/3 increments, the next discrete level lies exactly 1/3 below the known maximum, and two different Euclidean congruence classes share that maximum in populations 6 and 24. These structural facts are not encoded by ordinary vertex/facet counts or the previously known maximum and are useful benchmarks for polyhedral tetrahedralizations and extremal simplex geometry.
